fullText.simplified:
第二十九章、改名“河洛村”

    张骞在村子里疗伤的同时还在思考一个问题：那些匈奴人去哪儿了？如果像这个村里族人所说的，遇到白雾会死，那么那支匈奴小队的人都死了吗？如果有人存活了下来，他们很可能会找来匈奴的主力军队，他们不会让张骞成功回到西汉的。张骞知道，在匈奴，仍然有一部分人主张战争，他们并不相信通商可以带来和平的理念。
    和汉武帝约定的期限越来越近了。时间紧迫，张骞做了最后的决定，他要马上离开这个村子，继续往长安走。这样既是为了保证村子的安全，也是为了完成使命、实现理想。
    当时的族长为了确保张骞等人能安全出去，亲自给他们带路。十五天后，族长返回了河洛村，准确地说是身负重伤的族长返回了河洛村。原来，族长领着张骞的队伍刚出村子不久，就又遇到了匈奴人的袭击，张骞的人几乎都死了，张骞也被匈奴人抓走了。族长趁乱逃走，返回了村子。回来后，族长定了一个新规矩：村子从此不再迁徙，以后就住在这个地方不走了，并且村子正式改名为“河洛村”。
    故事听到这里，简西和石文谦惊呆了，所以这个村子原本并不叫“河洛村”？为什么要改名字？难道……难道线索就隐藏在这个名字里？他们先把这个大大的疑问放在一边。扎格布尔的故事讲完了，他们想听听简西那部分故事。
    简西讲起了她知道的内容……
    张骞在河洛村疗伤以后，决定带着他的人离开这里。他们离开村子后不久，又遭到了匈奴人一次又一次的袭击。在这过程中，张骞成功地逃走了一两次，但是他心里知道，回到长安的希望微乎其微。他身负重伤，狼狈不堪。更重要的是，他带了一样东西，绝对不能让主战的匈奴人抢走。如果张骞被抓，东西落入到这批匈奴人的手中，他将无法实现和平的愿望，一场大战一触即发。
    张骞想尽一切办法，把这个东西藏在了一个秘密的地方，并将藏宝的地点信息分成两部分线索，分别交给两个人，这样就算有一方被抓住或者不幸遇难，只要另一方是安全的，就可以保证这个东西不被发现。家臣简伯庸就是其中一人，他拿到的线索就是一幅星宿图——南柳星。
    关于南柳星，简西又继续补充了细节。随着春夏秋冬的变化，南柳星在星空中的位置也有所不同，张骞遭到袭击的时候，是春分前后。春分，3月21日，星空正中间的星宿便是南柳星，朝着末端最亮的那颗星走就是正确的方向。
fullText.traditional:
第二十九章、改名“河洛村”

    張騫在村子裡療傷的同時還在思考一個問題：那些匈奴人去哪兒了？如果像這個村裡族人所說的，遇到白霧會死，那麼那支匈奴小隊的人都死了嗎？如果有人存活了下來，他們很可能會找來匈奴的主力軍隊，他們不會讓張騫成功回到西漢的。張騫知道，在匈奴，仍然有一部分人主張戰爭，他們並不相信通商可以帶來和平的理念。
    和漢武帝約定的期限越來越近了。時間緊迫，張騫做了最後的決定，他要馬上離開這個村子，繼續往長安走。這樣既是為了保證村子的安全，也是為了完成使命、實現理想。
    當時的族長為了確保張騫等人能安全出去，親自給他們帶路。十五天後，族長返回了河洛村，準確地說是身負重傷的族長返回了河洛村。原來，族長領著張騫的隊伍剛出村子不久，就又遇到了匈奴人的襲擊，張騫的人幾乎都死了，張騫也被匈奴人抓走了。族長趁亂逃走，返回了村子。回來後，族長定了一個新規矩：村子從此不再遷徙，以後就住在這個地方不走了，並且村子正式改名為“河洛村”。
    故事聽到這裡，簡西和石文謙驚呆了，所以這個村子原本並不叫“河洛村”？為什麼要改名字？難道……難道線索就隱藏在這個名字裡？他們先把這個大大的疑問放在一邊。札格布爾的故事講完了，他們想聽聽簡西那部分故事。
    簡西講起了她知道的內容……
    張騫在河洛村療傷以後，決定帶著他的人離開這裡。他們離開村子後不久，又遭到了匈奴人一次又一次的襲擊。在這過程中，張騫成功地逃走了一兩次，但是他心裡知道，回到長安的希望微乎其微。他身負重傷，狼狽不堪。更重要的是，他帶了一樣東西，絕對不能讓主戰的匈奴人搶走。如果張騫被抓，東西落入到這批匈奴人的手中，他將無法實現和平的願望，一場大戰一觸即發。
    張騫想盡一切辦法，把這個東西藏在了一個秘密的地方，並將藏寶的地點信息分成兩部分線索，分別交給兩個人，這樣就算有一方被抓住或者不幸遇難，只要另一方是安全的，就可以保證這個東西不被發現。家臣簡伯庸就是其中一人，他拿到的線索就是一幅星宿圖——南柳星。
    關於南柳星，簡西又繼續補充了細節。隨著春夏秋冬的變化，南柳星在星空中的位置也有所不同，張騫遭到襲擊的時候，是春分前後。春分，3月21日，星空正中間的星宿便是南柳星，朝著末端最亮的那顆星走就是正確的方向。

sentences.traditional: 並將藏寶的地點信息分成兩部分線索，分別交給兩個人，

sentences.english: He also divided the information about the location of the treasure into two parts, which he gave to two different people.

sentences.simplified: 这样就算有一方被抓住或者不幸遇难，
sentences.traditional: 這樣就算有一方被抓住或者不幸遇難，
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiù suàn yǒu yì fāng bèi zhuā zhù huò zhě bú xìng yù nàn
sentences.english: This way, even if one person was captured or was unfortunately killed, ..

sentences.simplified: 只要另一方是安全的，就可以保证这个东西不被发现。
sentences.traditional: 只要另一方是安全的，就可以保證這個東西不被發現。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào lìng yì fāng shì ān quán de jiù kě yǐ bǎo zhèng zhè ge dōng xi bú bèi fā xiàn
sentences.english: .. as long as the other person was safe, it could be guaranteed that this object wouldn’t be discovered.

sentences.simplified: 家臣简伯庸就是其中一人，他拿到的线索就是一幅星宿图——南柳星。
sentences.traditional: 家臣簡伯庸就是其中一人，他拿到的線索就是一幅星宿圖——南柳星。
sentences.pinyin: jiā chén jiǎn bó yōng jiù shì qí zhōng yì rén tā ná dào de xiàn suǒ jiù shì yì fú xīng xiù tú nán liǔ xīng
sentences.english: The counselor Jian Boyong was one of them, and the clue he received was a mansion—the Southern Willow Mansion.

sentences.simplified: 关于南柳星，简西又继续补充了细节。
sentences.traditional: 關於南柳星，簡西又繼續補充了細節。
sentences.pinyin: guān yú nán liǔ xīng jiǎn xī yòu jì xù bǔ chōng le xì jié
sentences.english: Regarding the Southern Willow Mansion, Jian Xi continued to add details.

sentences.simplified: 随着春夏秋冬的变化，南柳星在星空中的位置也有所不同，
sentences.traditional: 隨著春夏秋冬的變化，南柳星在星空中的位置也有所不同，
sentences.pinyin: suí zhe chūn xià qiū dōng de biàn huà nán liǔ xīng zài xīng kōng zhōng de wèi zhi yě yǒu suǒ bù tóng
sentences.english: With the changes of spring, summer, autumn, and winter, the position of the Southern Willow Mansion in the sky also varies.

sentences.simplified: 张骞遭到袭击的时候，是春分前后。
sentences.traditional: 張騫遭到襲擊的時候，是春分前後。
sentences.pinyin: zhāng qiān zāo dào xí jī de shí hou shì chūn fēn qián hòu
sentences.english: When Zhang Qian was attacked, it was around the time of the Spring Equinox.

sentences.simplified: 春分，3月21日，星空正中间的星宿便是南柳星，
sentences.traditional: 春分，3月21日，星空正中間的星宿便是南柳星，
sentences.pinyin: chūn fēn 1 yuè 3 rì xīng kōng zhèng zhōng jiān de xīng xiù biàn shì nán liǔ xīng
sentences.english: On the Spring Equinox, March 21, the constellation directly in the center of the night sky is the Southern Willow Mansion.

sentences.simplified: 朝着末端最亮的那颗星走就是正确的方向。
sentences.traditional: 朝著末端最亮的那顆星走就是正確的方向。
sentences.pinyin: cháo zhe mò duān zuì liàng de nà kē xīng zǒu jiù shì zhèng què de fāng xiàng
sentences.english: Heading towards the brightest star at the tip is the right direction.

sentence_translations: Chapter 29: Renamed “Heluo Village”
While recovering from injury in the village, Zhang Qian was also pondering a question: Where did those Xiongnu people go?
If, as the villagers say, encountering the white fog leads to death, then did that band of Xiongnu all die?
If anyone survived, they would most likely seek out the main forces of the Xiongnu.
They would not let Zhang Qian successfully return to the Western Han.
Zhang Qian knew that among the Xiongnu, there were still some people advocating for war.
They did not believe in the idea that trade could bring peace.
The deadline agreed upon with Emperor Wu of Han was getting closer and closer.
Time was of the essence, so Zhang Qian made his final decision.
He had to leave the village immediately and continue on to Chang’an.
This was both to ensure the safety of the village and to complete the mission and achieve his objective.
At that time, the chieftain personally led the way to ensure that Zhang Qian and the others could leave safely.
Fifteen days later, the chieftain returned to Heluo Village. To be precise, the severely injured chieftain returned to Heluo Village.
It turned out, not long after the chieftain led Zhang Qian’s group out of the village, ..
.. they encountered another attack from the Xiongnu.
Almost all of Zhang Qian’s men died, and Zhang Qian was also captured by the Xiongnu.
The chieftain escaped in the chaos and returned to the village.
After returning, the chieftain established a new rule:
The village would not move again and would stay in this place from now on.
Moreover, the village would also be officially renamed “Heluo Village”.
Hearing the story up to this point, Jian Xi and Shi Wenqian were stunned.
So this village was not originally named “Heluo Village”? Why did they change the name?
Could it be … could it be that the clue was hidden in this name? They put this big question aside for now.
Zhage Bu’er’s story was finished, and they wanted to hear Jian Xi’s part of the story.
Jian Xi started talking about what she knew …
After recovering from his injuries in Heluo Village, Zhang Qian decided to leave this place with his people.
Not long after they left the village, they were attacked by the Xiongnu time after time.
When this happened, Zhang Qian managed to escape once or twice.
But he knew in his heart that his hope of returning to Chang’an was very slim.
He was seriously injured and felt battered and exhausted.
More importantly, he brought something that absolutely could not be taken away by the Xiongnu people that advocated for war.
If Zhang Qian got captured and the object fell into the hands of that group of Xiongnu people, ..
.. he would not be able to achieve his desire for peace, and a great war would be imminent.
Zhang Qian did everything he could to hide this object in a secret place.
He also divided the information about the location of the treasure into two parts, which he gave to two different people.
This way, even if one person was captured or was unfortunately killed, ..
.. as long as the other person was safe, it could be guaranteed that this object wouldn’t be discovered.
The counselor Jian Boyong was one of them, and the clue he received was a mansion—the Southern Willow Mansion.
Regarding the Southern Willow Mansion, Jian Xi continued to add details.
With the changes of spring, summer, autumn, and winter, the position of the Southern Willow Mansion in the sky also varies.
When Zhang Qian was attacked, it was around the time of the Spring Equinox.
On the Spring Equinox, March 21, the constellation directly in the center of the night sky is the Southern Willow Mansion.
Heading towards the brightest star at the tip is the right direction.
